dct_description_sm: The dataset has been developed to study the microwave emissions coming off the sea ice, surface snow and sea water. The emissions can be used for various applications such as understanding growth and melting of sea ice in different seasons. Depending on the turbulence in the ocean and the atmospheric boundary layer, the emissions will correspond to different turbulence conditions. So, the turbulence in the boundary layer can be studied using this data.  The microwave emissions depend upon the dielectric properties of the surface. Different ice types have different dielectric properties. Thus information on types of ice can be inferred from this data. These parameters are good indicators of climate change.
dct_title_s: Surface-Based Radiometer (SBR) data from the South Beaufort Sea, aboard the Amundsen icebreaker
